parole.significato: The third letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet C, from Czech C, from Latin C, from Etruscan 𐌂 (c), from Ancient Greek Γ (G, Gamma), from Phoenician 𐤂 (g, giml). Pronunciation as IPA⁽ᵏᵉʸ⁾: /cə/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably taken from German C.

parole.significato: The eighth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet G, from Czech alphabet G, from Latin G, from a modification of the Latin letter C (“ce”), from the Etruscan letter 𐌂 (c, “ce”), from the Ancient Greek letter Γ (G, “gamma”), derived from the Phoenician letter 𐤂 (g, “giml”), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓌙. Pronunciation as /

parole.significato: The ninth letter of the Slovene alphabet, written in the Latin script.
parole.testo: From Gaj's Latin alphabet H, from Czech alphabet H, from Latin Latin H, from Etruscan 𐌇 (h, he), from Ancient Greek Η (Ē, eta), from 𐤇 (ḥ, het), from the Egyptian hieroglyph 𓈈 or maybe 𓉗. Pronunciation as /xə/ is initial Slovene (phoneme plus a fill vowel) and the second pronunciation is probably ta
